name: dumbbell over bench neutral wrist curl
description: Forearms rest over the end of a bench with palms facing in, and you move the dumbbells with your wrists. It builds forearm strength and grip.
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest your forearms on it, hands just past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other, thumbs up.
Keep your forearms on the bench and tilt the dumbbells up by bending at the wrists.
Pause, then let them tilt down as far as is comfortable.
